name: theSVG
summary: Open-source library of 7,400+ brand, cloud and Kubernetes SVG icons with npm packages, CLI, CDN and MCP server.
description: Brand and cloud SVG icons: 7,400+ icons across brand logos, AWS Architecture, Azure Services, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, auth badges and community collections, each in up to 7 variants (color, mono, light, dark, wordmark). Available as typed npm packages for React, Vue, Svelte and React Native, a CLI, static CDN URLs, a JSON manifest and an MCP server for AI agents.
contains: 7,400+ SVG icons in 7 collections: Brand, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Community, Auth Badges
4,675 brand icons across 115+ categories; 12,300+ total variants
Up to 7 variants per icon: color, mono, light, dark, wordmark, wordmarkLight, wordmarkDark
npm packages for React, Vue, Svelte and React Native, plus a CLI and MCP server
Static JSON manifests (/api/registry.json, /api/categories.json) and CDN URLs, no auth required
Figma, VS Code, Raycast, Neovim, Alfred and browser extensions; MCP server for AI tools
